The source URL points to a specific tagged release archive (version 0.9.6), and a SHA-1 checksum is provided for integrity verification, which is a reasonable practice even if not the strongest hash algorithm.

The package function installs the built binary and associated desktop files (application launcher and icon) into standard system directories under `$pkgdir`, which is the expected and safe behavior for a package manager. All dependencies are legitimate and relevant to the application: `mkvtoolnix-cli` for core MKV processing and `gtkmm3` for the GUI. The build-time dependencies are also standard development tools. No post-install hooks or systemd services are present. The duplicate installation of the desktop file appears to be a packaging error but does not introduce a security risk. Overall, the PKGBUILD follows standard AUR practices and shows no signs of malicious intent or supply chain compromise.
